acts.title: Lei Constitucional n.o 1/2005
acts.note: Seventh constitutional revision (2005, two columns): 3 articles, then the whole Constitution republished after the signatures without an 'ANEXO' line; the issue's back cover shares the last page

acts.title: Lei Constitucional n.o 1/97
acts.note: Fourth constitutional revision (1997), the oldest layout with a text layer: two columns with an off-centre gutter, split running heads, parts 'I — ...', '««' misprint; other acts (avisos) follow in the extract

acts.title: Lei n.º 7/2009
acts.note: Law approving the Código do Trabalho, published as one annex (the code's own structure stays flat text)

acts.title: Decreto-Lei n.º 18/2008
acts.note: Decree-law approving the Código dos Contratos Públicos: long preamble, 4 chapters, the code as one annex keeping its own annexes I-VI

acts.title: Lei n.º 58/2019
acts.note: GDPR implementing law, by citation: 9 chapters, 4 sections; the annex republishes Lei 43/2004 with its own annex and MAPA I
Former data protection law (1998, two columns), cited with a two-digit year: 7 chapters, 11 sections

acts.title: Lei n.º 94/2017
acts.note: Amending law (Código Penal and others): articles with quoted provisions ('passam a ter a seguinte redação')

acts.identifier: Lei Orgânica n.º 2/2006, de 17 de abril
acts.title: Lei Orgânica n.o 2/2006
acts.note: Organic law amending the nationality law, with its republication as an annex; indented quotations outnumber body lines on the first page

acts.title: Portaria n.º 1/2025
acts.note: Ministerial order in the 2021+ layout (side reference, 'Pág. 1/5'): summary with a hanging indent, ministers' dated signatures, republication annex

acts.title: Lei n.º 1/2026
acts.note: Recent amending law (January 2026): alterations, additions and systematic changes to Decreto-Lei 98-A/2025

acts.title: Decreto-Lei n.º 1/2026
acts.note: The same decree-law requested by its full ELI URI

acts.title: Código Penal
acts.note: Penal Code by name (Legislação Consolidada), version in force on 2021-01-01: the index of the official consolidated PDF of that date lists 439 articles (16 repealed) and 97 Livro/Título/Capítulo/Secção/Subsecção headings, plus the code annexed to Decreto-Lei 48/95; latest entry into force 2020-10-01 (Lei 39/2020)

acts.title: Código do Trabalho
acts.note: Labour Code by the citation of its approving law, without date: official consolidated PDF index of 2026-01-01 lists 615 articles (14 of the law, 2 repealed) and 149 Livro/Título/Subtítulo/Capítulo/Secção/Subsecção/Divisão headings plus the Anexo holding the code

acts.title: Código Civil
acts.note: Civil Code (1966) by name: official consolidated PDF index of 2026-01-01 lists 2405 articles (129 repealed) and 486 division headings down to Subdivisão, plus the Anexo holding the code

acts.title: Constituição da República Portuguesa
acts.note: Constitution by the address of its consolidated page (no ELI): 296 articles, 4 Partes, 19 Títulos, 24 Capítulos and the unnumbered groups 'Princípios fundamentais' and 'Disposições finais e transitórias'; four preamble paragraphs; unchanged since the 2005 revision

acts.title: Lei da Protecção de Dados Pessoais
acts.note: Former data protection law as in force on 2018-01-01 (repealed by Lei 58/2019): official consolidated PDF of that date lists 53 articles, 7 chapters and 11 sections; latest entry into force 2015-09-23 (Lei 103/2015)

acts.title: Lei n.º 43/2004
acts.note: Data protection authority law by its consolidated ELI (the consolidation of 2019-08-08 republished by Lei 58/2019, in force from 2019-08-09): 38 articles in 6 chapters and the annex MAPA I

acts.title: Código do Procedimento Administrativo
acts.note: Administrative Procedure Code: official consolidated PDF index of 2021-01-01 lists 212 articles (9 of the decree-law) and 50 Parte/Título/Capítulo/Secção/Subsecção headings plus the Anexo holding the code
